x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment - the-decision-as-a-walked-process task 10.1 (REQ-DWP-010). `committee` was already a stepKind value (fragments 80 and 89), but a committee step had no way to say WHICH governance body decides it. This adds `committeeBody` to the ApprovalRoute step and to DecisionStage; ApprovalRouteStepMapper copies it onto the stage at instantiation, like stepKind, and CommitteeStepGuard names the body when it refuses a single actor's act on the stage. Properties only, so no schema version moves, as in 134-decision-authority-basis.

committeeBody.title: Committee body
committeeBody.description: The governance body that decides a step of kind `committee`, in a meeting. Ignored on any other step kind. One person cannot close a committee step (REQ-DWP-010).

committeeBody.title: Committee body
committeeBody.description: The governance body that decides this stage when its stepKind is `committee`. COPIED onto the stage at instantiation, not read back off the route: editing a route must never change what a stage already in flight means (REQ-AR-012).
